title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Ferrari Enzo
description:
The Ferrari Enzo is one of the most famous supercars ever built, but two things about it are rarely explained properly. One is a piece of technology that Formula One itself would not allow. The other is that a Maserati is hiding underneath. Here are two secrets inside the Ferrari Enzo, and every place where our sources disagree. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the Enzo and the F50, RM Sotheby's catalogue pages, Sports Car Market, Hagerty's valuation page, the magazine evo, Jalopnik and the Italian site Italpassion. They conflict on production totals, prices and even the charity behind the last car. We show each version. Our own arithmetic is always labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

0:00 Intro
0:52 The car in brief
2:09 Secret one: technology Formula One banned
4:53 Secret one, continued: the numbers behind the claims
7:05 Secret two: a Maserati underneath
10:13 Who was allowed to buy one
12:43 The value today
15:02 A note on looks
16:12 More things hidden in the Enzo story
21:29 What the sources do not say
